population.png.decode: v == 0: below min (empty); else density = 10^(log10(min) + (v-1)/254 * (log10(max) - log10(min)))
population.png.period: GeoNames snapshot bundled with geonamescache 3.0.2 (populations of mixed census years)
population.png.method: Gaussian kernel density on the sphere: listed place populations with sigma 25 km plus each country's unlisted remainder (country total minus listed places) shared equally among its places with sigma 60 km; values above max clipped
population.png.source: GeoNames populated places >= 500 inhabitants (cities500, 234908 places) and GeoNames country populations, via the geonamescache 3.0.2 PyPI package
population.png.note: Modelled from settlement points and national totals, not a census grid: good for the global pattern, not for local values.

citylights.png.units: relative brightness (people/km² of a 6 km + 30 km kernel mix)
citylights.png.decode: v == 0: dark; else t = ((v-1)/254)^(1/gamma), value = 10^(log10(min) + t*(log10(max)-log10(min)))
citylights.png.method: Synthetic night lights: listed place populations with a sigma 6 km kernel plus 0.25 x a sigma 30 km glow (computed at 4x resolution, box-downsampled) plus 0.1 x the unlisted rural density
citylights.png.source: GeoNames populated places >= 500 inhabitants (cities500, 234908 places) and GeoNames country populations, via the geonamescache 3.0.2 PyPI package
citylights.png.note: Not satellite night-light data: brightness follows population only.

sst.png.decode: v == 0: land / no data; else T = min + (v-1)/254 * (max - min)
sst.png.period: 1991-2020 annual mean (mean of 360 monthly means, day-weighted)
sst.png.method: ERSST v5 2° grid, gaps under land filled with the nearest ocean value, bilinear upsampling to 0.25°, masked with Natural Earth 50m land and Antarctic ice shelves (large lakes kept where ERSST has values: Caspian, Great Lakes)
sst.png.source: NOAA Extended Reconstructed SST v5 (ERSST v5; Huang et al. 2017), monthly 1970-2021 file from github.com/pydata/xarray-data (ersstv5.nc)
sst.png.license: Public domain (NOAA; no constraints on data access or use)
sst.png.attribution: NOAA ERSST v5 (Huang et al., 2017, doi:10.1175/JCLI-D-16-0836.1)

temperature.png.decode: T = min + (v-1)/254 * (max - min) (no 0 values: global coverage)
temperature.png.period: 2005 annual mean (mean of the 12 monthly means of a single year, not a 30-year normal)
temperature.png.method: ERA-Interim 2 m temperature on its ~0.7° Gaussian grid, day-weighted annual mean, bilinear upsampling to 0.25°
temperature.png.source: ECMWF ERA-Interim reanalysis, 2 metre temperature, monthly means Jan-Dec 2005 (file T2M_ERAINT_rectilinear_grid_2D.nc from github.com/NCAR/geocat-datafiles)
temperature.png.attribution: Contains modified ECMWF ERA-Interim data (Dee et al., 2011)

precipitation.png.method: GPCP v2.2 2.5° monthly rates x days per month summed per year and averaged, bilinear upsampling to 0.25°
precipitation.png.source: GPCP Version 2.2 combined precipitation (Adler et al. 2003; Huffman et al. 2009), monthly 1979-2010 (file V22_GPCP.1979-2010.nc from github.com/NCAR/geocat-datafiles)
precipitation.png.license: Public domain (NASA GSFC / NOAA NCEI, free and open; citation requested)
precipitation.png.attribution: GPCP v2.2, NASA GSFC (Adler et al., 2003; Huffman et al., 2009)

koppen.png.decode: colour -> class via koppen-classes.json; alpha 0 = ocean / no data; one pixel per 0.5° grid cell
koppen.png.source: Köppen-Geiger 0.5° grid (Kottek et al. 2006; Rubel et al. 2017) as embedded in the npm package koppen-climate-lookup 2.0.0
koppen.png.license: Free data from koeppen-geiger.vu-wien.ac.at, citation required (no other licence stated); npm package ISC
koppen.png.attribution: Köppen-Geiger classification after Kottek et al. (2006) and Rubel et al. (2017), colours after Beck et al. (2018)
